_whyTheCapMovesHere: The built-in Limit Candidates node runs after this one and keeps the first maxEnrich items. A profile this node remembered but the limit cut would later be skipped without ever being evaluated. So in phase 1 this node applies the same cap (the limit's expression resolves to Resolve Search Tier.maxEnrich in phase 1), and the limit never cuts. In phase 2 this node does not cap, leaving today's behaviour untouched.
